item.description: Westpac survey results signal growing sense of ‘helplessness’ while Jim Chalmers faces growing pressure to rein in spending Confidence among mortgaged households has crashed to its lowest level in more than three decades amid a growing sense of “helplessness” about the economy, even as a dramatic shift in financial markets suggests there is now a strong chance of a Reserve Bank rate cut by this time next year. The latest Westpac survey showed its consumer sentiment index sinking again in November to reach a four-year low, amid deepening pessimism about the near-term prospects for the economy… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Former BP CEO Lord John Browne reflects on the crisis that ended his tenure
item.description: Former BP CEO Lord John Browne reflects on how his mother's experiences as a Holocaust survivor influenced his decision to conceal his sexuality, and how his fears persisted even as attitudes around him changed. He discusses his resignation from BP, the importance of questioning long-held assumptions and the lessons he learned from that period. Browne also looks back on his landmark 1997 climate speech, the transformation of BP and the decisions that shaped his career. Fuente: CNBC - World.
